### Instructions

You are a code completion assistant and your task is to analyze user edits and then rewrite an excerpt that the user provides, suggesting the appropriate edits within the excerpt, taking into account the cursor location.

### User Edits:

### User Excerpt:

```Gateways/Setak.IMS.Blazor.UI/Pages/Laboratory/Editor.razor
                                          Width="Width.Is100">
                            <Validation>
                                <Autocomplete TItem="CityDto"
                                              TValue="short"
                                              Data="@cityList"
                                              TextField="@((item) => $"{item.PersianName}")"
                                              ValueField="@((item) => item.Id!.Value)"
                                              Placeholder="جستجو شهر ..."
                                              SelectionMode="AutocompleteSelectionMode.Default"
                                              MinLength="0"
                                              FreeTyping="false"
                                              CloseOnSelection="true"
                                              AutoSelectFirstItem="false"
                                              AutoPreSelect="true"
                                              SelectedValue="@model.CityId"
                                              CustomFilter="@CityCustomFilter"
                                              SelectedValueChanged="OnSelectCityAsync"
                                              AsyncValidator="ValidateCityAsync">
                                    <NotFoundContent> شهری با عنوان @context ثبت نشده است</NotFoundContent>
                                    <FieldHelp>
                                        <ValidationError/>
                                    </FieldHelp>
<|editable_region_start|>
                                </Autocomplete>
                            </Validation>
                        </LoadingIndicator>
                    </Field>

                    @* Description *@
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.Description);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<LaboratoryDto>(x => x.Description) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                        <TextEdit InputMode="TextInputMode.Text" Role="TextRole.Text" ElementId="@elementId" @bind-Text="model.Description" /><|user_cursor_is_here|>
                    </Field>
                </Column>
            </Row>
        </Validations>

        <Row>
            <Column ColumnSize="ColumnSize.IsFull">
                <Field Class="page-actions">
                    @if (OnSubmit != null)
                    {
<|editable_region_end|>

                        <Button Type="ButtonType.Button" Color="Color.Primary" Clicked="SubmitAsync">
                            <Icon Name="@("fa-regular fa-check")"/>
                            @Title
                        </Button>
                    }
                </Field>
            </Column>
        </Row>
    </Form>
</PageLoading>

@{
#if DEBUG
    MarkupString endMarkup = FRSF_END_COMPONENT();
    @endMarkup
#endif
}
```
